(rule!
 ;; Headers as axes: cell (i,j) lights with the shared color when the i-th
 ;; LEFT header equals the j-th TOP header (headers dropped from the output).
 (let ((top (rest (first g)))
       (left (map first (rest g))))
   (grid-from-fn (length left) (length top) (lambda (r c)
     (let ((lv (list-ref left r)) (tv (list-ref top c)))
       (if (and (!= lv 0) (= lv tv)) lv 0))))))
